name: mcp-arcade 0.2.0
body: Eight waves after the 0.1.0 floor. The sentence on the tin still holds: the oracle is the JSON-RPC wire plus the sandbox, and nothing added here grades anything else. The seat is a policy, not a judge; dataset labels…

Wave 1 — the harness survives a real server: --framing auto|ndjson|content-length, protocolVersion negotiation, --task / --args, --wrap, --timeout, server requests rejected. Decisions: docs/wave-1.md.

Wave 2 — Docker is the sandbox: --target docker, one fresh container per atom, image id pinned and drift-checked, /sandbox snapshotted from inside, no host binds by default. Decisions: docs/wave-2.md.
Wave 3 — mcp-arcade dataset: one JSONL row per atom, labels from the wire, split: proof never trains. Decisions: docs/wave-3.md.
Wave 4 — the agent seat: --agent ollama:<model>, frozen template hashed onto the receipt, model text dropped before the receipt, no-call is a utility SKIP. Decisions: docs/wave-4.md.
